replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: Yes, absolutely. Math triggers a lot of anxiety in me. I still remember the stress from school exams. replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: Honestly, no. I haven't used AI for math learning recently. I prefer traditional methods or just avoiding the topic entirely.
